rule: Load closure/postmortem files and assert no-trade default; no active strategy implementation-ready.
Collect public ideas only from academic/arXiv/SSRN, Quantpedia summaries, Freqtrade/Jesse examples, TradingView public scripts, exchange education, and reputable quant blogs.
Reject paid/proprietary claims, private groups, unverifiable PnL screenshots, and any source requiring code copying.
Map each idea to one of A-L families; merge duplicates rather than creating many variants.
Create exactly one simple representative candidate per executable family before testing; no parameter sweep.
Use same 19 markets where data exists; document exclusions before results; BTCUSDT/DOGE/DOT/UNI always visible.
Run all executable candidates under same split/data/fee/slippage/risk assumptions; compare to no-trade, passive BTC, per-market buy-hold, and failed references.
Automatically fail candidates hitting fail gates; no tuning after result.
Report candidate count, executable count, failures, cautions, promotions, and no-trade interpretation.
